title: Young Florida Man Gives Cops a Run For Their Money
description:
North Miami Beach bodycam footage shows a routine window tint stop turn chaotic when 22-year-old Jonathan Rivas-Gonzalez shoves an officer and flees, crashing into multiple vehicles before being caught on foot.
